notes:
# EXCESS 0.4.54

**Visualizers**
- **Tremolo:** fixed the waveform clipping off the bottom of the panel at higher Depth —
  the whole wave now stays cleanly below the rate readout at any depth, with a subtle,
  epilepsy-safe on-beat glow.
- **Phaser:** brand-new "Notch Field" display — moving notches drift across a soft
  spectrum field so you can read the sweep at a glance; clean and calm (no motion
  sickness), and it tracks the real sweep rate.
- **Flanger:** fixed the high-end "scrunch" — the top of the sweep stays clear in motion.

**Learn / dynamics**
- **Compressor & Multiband Comp:** more accurate **Learn** (loudness-weighted analysis,
  slightly longer learn window). Multiband **M/S/B** buttons now stay centered under each
  band as you drag the crossovers, and a stray glyph on the Learn button is fixed.

**Layout & fixes**
- **EQ & Reverb:** band dials and their readouts are centered and no longer crowd the
  band buttons or the band name.
- **Auto Filter:** widened so the full "Unipolar"/"Bipolar" label is visible.
- **Trance Gate:** custom step counts (e.g. 7 or 11) now loop cleanly instead of
  restarting mid-cycle; 4/8/16/32 still lock to the downbeat.
- **Multiband Exciter:** hardened against a rare runaway "feedback"-like roar when many
  bands are driven hard (and against bad host samples) — no change to the normal sound.
- Broader "steer the eye" layout polish across the DT standalone effects.
